name: custom-material-verify
description: CUSTOMIZE-SAVE-MATERIAL: enter a room, save composed materials (incl. a scaled one) as named custom materials, apply them to the floor, and screenshot the picker (showing 'mine' tiles) + the 3D floor (confirming the saved + scaled finishes resolve and render).

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: enter-room
steps.eval: (() => { const st=window.__store.getState(); const room=st.floorPlan.rooms.find(r=>!r.external)||st.floorPlan.rooms[0]; st.enterRoomEditor(room.id); window.__roomId = room.id; return room.id; })()

steps.name: save-materials
steps.eval: (() => { const st=window.__store.getState(); st.saveMaterial({ finishId:'compose:hexagon:#cc4444', name:'Crimson hex', category:'floor' }); st.saveMaterial({ finishId:'compose:tile:#3a7bd5@0.4', name:'Fine blue tile', category:'floor' }); st.saveMaterial({ finishId:'tint:wall-paint-white:#2a9d6f', name:'Emerald paint', category:'wall' }); return st.savedMaterials.length; })()
